novel_features.name: Duplicate-issue finder
novel_features.description: Find open issues whose title and body match a term, ranked by relevance, so you spot duplicates before re-triaging.
novel_features.rationale: Runs a local FTS5 query over the synced issue corpus offline, surviving GitHub's 30-requests-per-minute search ceiling that throttles repeated online triage sweeps.
novel_features.example: github-pp-cli issues dupes "panic on nil map" --repo cli/cli --limit 10
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when triaging a new issue and you need to know whether it duplicates an existing one without burning the search rate limit.

novel_features.name: Cross-entity term hunter
novel_features.description: One query across issue bodies, PR comments, and commit messages returning every place a symbol or error string appears, tagged by entity type.
novel_features.rationale: A single local SQL UNION over the FTS5 tables produces a cross-entity answer no individual GitHub API call can express.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this over per-resource search when you need every reference to a symbol across issues, PRs, and commits at once.

novel_features.name: Agent context bundle
novel_features.description: Assemble one JSON envelope for an issue: the issue, its comments, and the recent commits that mention it, ready for an agent to act on.
novel_features.rationale: Collapses what would be several rate-limited online calls into a single offline read from the local mirror, shaped for tool-calling agents.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this as the first call when an agent is assigned an issue and needs its full working set in one shot instead of N round-trips.

novel_features.name: Review-backlog by reviewer
novel_features.description: Aggregate open PRs by requested reviewer to show who has the largest unactioned review queue.
novel_features.rationale: Joins pull requests to their requested reviewers and groups by login locally, an aggregation gh never computes across PRs.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this in a pre-release sweep to find the review bottleneck before it slips the release train.

novel_features.name: Stale-PR detector
novel_features.description: List open PRs with no new commit, review, or comment in N days, sorted by staleness with last-activity time.
novel_features.rationale: Computes the latest activity timestamp per PR across multiple local tables, a staleness view the API does not return directly.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to decide which open PRs to nudge or close before they rot.

novel_features.name: Release diff by author
novel_features.description: List every commit between two refs, attach its PR when synced, and group by author for release-note prep.
novel_features.rationale: Combines a live compare for the SHA range with a local join of those commits to synced PRs and authors that a single API call cannot produce.
novel_features.example: github-pp-cli repos changelog --repo cli/cli --base v2.93.0 --head v2.94.0
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when drafting release notes and you need what merged since the last tag, organized by contributor.

novel_features.name: File ownership and churn
novel_features.description: For a file or directory prefix, rank committers by number of commits touching that path, with first and last touch dates.
novel_features.rationale: A local GROUP BY over synced commits filtered by path, producing a path-level ownership ranking gh does not offer.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when onboarding onto an unfamiliar area to find who knows a file before you ask around.

novel_features.name: Label coverage report
novel_features.description: Report each label's open and closed issue and PR counts, and flag labels that are defined but unused and issues that are unlabeled.
novel_features.rationale: A local GROUP BY over the synced issue-label join surfaces unused labels and unlabeled issues that no single API call returns.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this during triage hygiene to prune dead labels and catch issues that slipped through unlabeled.

narrative.headline: Every gh issue, PR, repo, and code-search workflow, plus a local SQLite mirror, offline full-text search, and cross-entity joins no GitHub tool offers.
narrative.value_prop: github-pp-cli mirrors the GitHub collaboration core — issues, pull requests, commits, branches, contents, labels, releases, and search — into a local SQLite store you sync once and query offline forever. It matches the gh CLI and the official MCP server command-for-command on the scoped surfaces, then adds offline FTS search that survives GitHub's rate limits and local joins (issues to PRs to commits to authors) the online API cannot express in a single call.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set a personal access token in GITHUB_TOKEN (or GH_TOKEN). A fine-grained or classic PAT with the scopes your workflow needs works; read-only scopes suffice for sync and search. github-pp-cli doctor reports your token state and remaining rate-limit budget.

quickstart.comment: Confirm the binary, token, and rate-limit budget before doing real work.
Populate the local mirror from a repo and find duplicate issues offline.
Find a symbol across issues, PRs, and commits in one query.
See who owes the most reviews across all open PRs.

troubleshoots.fix: Authenticated REST is 5,000/hr and search is 30/min; populate once with --repo and read offline, and check budget with github-pp-cli doctor.

troubleshoots.symptom: A novel command returns empty results
troubleshoots.fix: Those commands read the local mirror — pass --repo owner/repo once to populate it (the framework sync cannot fill GitHub repo-scoped resources).
Set GITHUB_TOKEN (or run gh auth login) and re-check with github-pp-cli doctor.

narrative.when_to_use: Choose github-pp-cli when you need to query GitHub's issue, PR, commit, and code-search data repeatedly or offline, when you need cross-entity answers (a symbol across issues+PRs+commits, review backlog by reviewer, file ownership) that take multiple gh calls and a spreadsheet, or when an agent needs an issue's full working set in one rate-limit-friendly read.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI for GitHub Actions, workflow runs, or CI status — that surface is out of scope.
Do not use this CLI for org, team, or enterprise administration.
Do not use this CLI for git operations like clone, push, or rebase — use git.
Do not use this CLI for notifications, gists, or marketplace.

recipes.title: Triage duplicates before re-labeling
recipes.explanation: Populates the local mirror then FTS-matches synced issue titles/bodies so you label the canonical duplicate.

recipes.title: Find a symbol across everything
recipes.explanation: One local query returns every issue, PR, comment, and commit referencing the symbol, tagged by type.

recipes.title: Assemble an agent read-set for one issue
recipes.explanation: Returns the issue, its comments, and mentioning commits as one narrowed JSON envelope for a single offline read.

recipes.title: Find who owns a file before changing it
recipes.explanation: Ranks committers by commits touching the path so you know who to ask.
